Oliver — hi, Dev Patel here (Senior Security Engineer at Redwood). Per Stephanie's note, attaching our responses and a telemetry inventory export. High-level answers below; full responses are in the attached PDF/CSV.

TL;DR answers:
- SOC 2: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report covering period 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30. Attached: Redwood_Security_Responses.pdf (section 1).
- DPA/GDPR: We have a standard DPA; EU processing regions are supported in our EU region offering (data-at-rest and egress controls). See attachment (section 2).
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA customers via our Private deployment and we can execute a BAA; see BAA clause summary in the PDF.
- Vendor questionnaire: filled primary tabs in the spreadsheet you sent and noted items that require contract/legal review.
- Telemetry & cookies (console + docs): Attached Telemetry_Tracking_Inventory.csv includes: collection points (console UI, docs site, API analytics), destinations (internal analytics, Sentry, Segment, Cloud CDN logs), data categories (event names, timestamps, hashed identifiers, no raw PHI), and retention windows. Key points:
   * Console: we collect usage events and hashed user IDs; no full PHI fields are sent to third-party analytics.
   * Docs site: standard web analytics (page views, UTM), cookies for session and analytics; opt-out via browser Do Not Track + cookie banner on the docs host.
   * Default retention: application telemetry 90 days, aggregated metrics 2 years; retention configurable per customer for Dedicated/Private deployments.

Attachment list: Redwood_Security_Responses.pdf (PDF), Telemetry_Tracking_Inventory.csv (CSV), MedTech_Security_Q_2027.xlsx (filled tabs).

If anything in the spreadsheet looks insufficient, happy to jump on a 20–30 minute technical review. Suggested times: 2027-08-05 10:30–12:00 PT or 2027-08-06 08:00–11:00 PT.
